materials.name: 185HR
materials.notes: High reliability epoxy laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: Cure 190-200 C (maximum product temperature 205 C); 75 min above 190 C and 65 min above 200 C (15 min more above 3.0 mm); heat rise 3.0-4.5 C/min between 100 and 150 C; pressure 350-450 PSI (25-32 kg/cm2) without vacuum assist, 325-450 PSI with vacuum frames or bags, 275-400 PSI in a vacuum enclosure; dual stage starts at 50 PSI (3.5 kg/cm2) and goes to full pressure at 90 C; 65 min cure for sub-assemblies and 75 min for the final assembly; vacuum 10-20 min on risers; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; cool at 2.8 C/min.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: 370HR Ultra
materials.notes: Epoxy laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df). Prepreg melts and flows at about 11 C lower temperature than standard FR406 prepreg, so vacuum assist is suggested.

lamination.notes: Cure 182-185 C; 70-90 min above 182 C at the centre of the book (90 min above 3 mm); heat rise 2.0-6.0 C/min between 90 and 150 C (above 3.5 C/min for high layer count or 2 oz copper); pressure 300-400 PSI (21-28 kg/cm2) without vacuum assist and 250-400 PSI (18-28 kg/cm2) with vacuum; dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; 70-75 min cure for sub-assemblies and 90 min for the final assembly; vacuum 20 min on risers.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

processing.bake_note: Mild bake of oxided innerlayers 15-30 min at 80-100 C; dry layers at least 30 min at 100 C.

materials.name: Tachyon 200JV
materials.notes: Halogen-free, super low loss laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df). A high temperature post bake of 2 h at 210 C is listed; low heat rise rates give the best performance.

lamination.notes: Cure 120 min above 200 C and never above 222 C product temperature; heat rise 2-3 C/min between 115 and 160 C; pressure 400-450 PSI (26.5-30 kg/cm2), 425 PSI shown as the middle of the range; dual stage 100 PSI after vacuum dwell, full pressure at 130 C product temperature; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum on risers for at least 10 min with the product below 100 C.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter. Two tables are given; the maximum of both is shown.

materials.name: A11
materials.notes: No-flow specialty prepreg, general purpose difunctional epoxy; the guide gives about 100 C Tg typical by DSC.

lamination.notes: Cure at least 60 min at 182 C (80 min at 171 C may not develop full Tg; add 60 min for every 12.2 C below 182 C); the package must not exceed 192 C; heat rise 3.0-6.0 C/min between 79 and 135 C; full pressure 325-400 PSI (22.8-28.1 kg/cm2), 350 PSI suggested; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum 20 min; kiss cycles are not suggested.

materials.name: Astra MT77
materials.notes: Ultra low loss RF/MW laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df). It says to use lower chiploads and cutting speeds than standard FR-4 and that desmear can follow the 170 C Tg FR-4 parameters.

lamination.notes: Cure 190-200 C: 70 min at 190 C or 60 min at 200 C; heat rise 3.0-5.0 C/min; pressure 325-375 PSI (23-27 kg/cm2) for 1 oz copper and up to 18 layers, 350-400 PSI (25-28 kg/cm2) above; dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell; vacuum at least 15 min on risers with the product below 100 C; cool at 2.8 C/min to 135-140 C under 50 PSI; use the full press cycle for sub-assemblies and the final lamination.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: ED130UV
materials.notes: UV-blocking epoxy laminate; the guide has drilling data only in text form (no lamination table, Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter. Two tables are given (standard and undercut bits with high-speed spindles); the maximum of both is shown.

materials.name: FR402
materials.notes: Tetrafunctional epoxy laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: Cure 50 min above 180 C (70 min above 3 mm); heat rise 4.5-6.5 C/min between 80 and 135 C; pressure 200-250 PSI (14-18 kg/cm2); dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 20 min at cure temperature; vacuum 20 min on risers; cool at 2.8 C/min.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter. The guide suggests a maximum cutting speed of 550-600 SFPM and a chip load not above 3.5 mil for bits of 0.040 in and above.

materials.name: FR406
materials.notes: Standard loss, high Tg epoxy laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: Single stage: 50 min at 177 C (60-70 min from 3.2 mm); dual stage: 50 min at 185 C; heat rise 4.5-6.7 C/min between 79 and 135 C; pressure 200-350 PSI (14.1-24.6 kg/cm2), 275 PSI suggested (300-350 PSI without vacuum assist, 250-300 with vacuum frames or bags, 200-250 in a vacuum enclosure); dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell, full pressure when the centre of the stack is at 93 C; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 15 min at cure temperature; vacuum 20-30 min; cool at 2.8 C/min from 185 to 135 C; sequential lamination 50 min for sub-assemblies and 60-70 min for the final assembly.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter. Maximum cutting speed 550-600 SFPM; chip load not above 3.5 mil for bits of 0.040 in and above; stack height at most 200 mil of board thickness; at most 1000 hits for the smallest bits and 1500 for 13.5 mil and above.

processing.desmear_note: Conventional permanganate or plasma; for 3-point etchback a double permanganate pass or plasma followed by a chemical pass.
processing.bake_note: Mild bake of oxided innerlayers 15-30 min at 80-100 C; dry layers at least 30 min at 100 C.

materials.name: FR406N
materials.notes: No-flow and low-flow specialty prepreg, multifunctional epoxy; the guide gives about 170 C Tg typical by DSC.

lamination.notes: Cure at least 80 min at 185 C (60 min may not develop full Tg; add 60 min for every 12.2 C below the cure temperature); full pressure 325-400 PSI (22.8-28.1 kg/cm2), 350 PSI suggested; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum 20 min on lifters. Other pressure ranges in the guide: 350-400 PSI, 325-375 PSI hydraulic pressing and 175-200 PSI autoclave.

materials.name: FR408
materials.notes: Mid loss epoxy laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: Cure 185-200 C: 110 min above 185 C or 95 min above 191 C (thicker boards near the top of the range); heat rise 2.2-4.5 C/min between 100 and 150 C (above 3.5 C/min for high layer count or 2 oz copper); pressure 200-250 PSI (14-18 kg/cm2); dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell; vacuum 30 min on risers; sequential lamination 80 min for sub-assemblies and 95-110 min for the final assembly.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter. The guide advises lower chip loads than standard FR-4 for this material.

materials.name: FR408HR
materials.notes: Lead-free, mid loss laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: Cure 188-202 C; 130-160 min at or above 190 C (product overshoot to 205 C acceptable for the heat rise); heat rise 3.5-5.0 C/min between 100 and 150 C (target above 4 C/min); pressure 200-350 PSI (14-25 kg/cm2); dual stage 50 PSI (3.5 kg/cm2) after vacuum dwell and full pressure at 100 C product temperature; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum 30 min on risers; cool at 2.5 C/min to 135-140 C; sub-assemblies must be baked before the secondary lamination.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter. The guide advises lower chip loads than standard FR-4 for this material.

materials.name: G200
materials.peel_condition: Low profile and very low profile foil (all foil above 17 um): 1.14 N/mm; standard profile copper: 0.96 N/mm after thermal stress and 0.90 N/mm after process solutions (IPC-TM-650 2.4.8)
materials.notes: BT-epoxy laminate and prepreg for large panel, high layer count boards; laminate 0.05 to 3.2 mm (2 to 125 mil) as a range, copper 1/2, 1 and 2 oz, HTE grade 3 foil, thinner foil available; prepreg on E-glass, square weave or mechanically spread. Thermal conductivity 0.35 W/mK; volume resistivity 8.9e8 MOhm cm after moisture resistance (6.5e8 at elevated temperature) and surface resistivity 2.21e6 MOhm (4.4e8 at elevated temperature) converted to ohm; dielectric breakdown above 60 kV; CTI class 3 (175-249 V); Poisson's ratio 0.182 (lengthwise) and 0.160 (crosswise); thermal stress 10 s at 288 C passes (unetched and etched); Young's modulus 3489 and 3200 ksi converted to GPa; relative thermal index 130 C; UL file E41625; the t288 value is the minimum (above 10 min).

thickness_range.steps_note: The data sheet gives the range only (2 to 125 mil), no steps.

lamination.notes: Cure temperature 180 C (the guide says the standard FR-4 press cycles must be extended to cure it and gives no cure time); heat rise 3.5-5.5 C/min between 90 and 150 C; pressure 200-300 PSI (14-21 kg/cm2); dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell and full pressure at 90 C product temperature; vacuum 20 min on risers; cool at 2.8 C/min to 135-140 C under 50 PSI.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: I-Tera MT40
materials.notes: Very low loss laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: 60 min at 200 C; heat rise 3.0-5.0 C/min; pressure 325-375 PSI (23-27 kg/cm2) for 1 oz copper and up to 18 layers, 350-400 PSI (25-28 kg/cm2) above; dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell and full pressure at 90 C product temperature; vacuum at least 15 min on risers; use the full cycle for sub-assemblies and the final lamination.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: I-Tera MT40 (RF/MW)
materials.notes: Very low loss RF/MW laminate (laminate only); the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: 60 min at 200 C; heat rise 3.0-5.0 C/min; pressure 325-375 PSI (23-27 kg/cm2) for 1 oz copper and up to 18 layers, 350-400 PSI (25-28 kg/cm2) above; dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell; vacuum at least 15 min on risers.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: IS400
materials.notes: Lead-free, mid Tg epoxy laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: 60 min above 180 C (75 min above 3 mm); heat rise 2.5-3.5 C/min; pressure 225-300 PSI (16-21 kg/cm2); dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell and full pressure at 80 C product temperature; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum 20 min on risers; 60 min cure for sub-assemblies and 60-70 min for the final assembly; the temperature shown is the one the cure time counts above.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: IS410
materials.notes: Lead-free epoxy laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: 75 min above 185 C (90 min for thicker boards); heat rise 2.2-4.5 C/min between 80 and 135 C (above 3.5 C/min for high layer count or 2 oz copper); pressure 200-250 PSI (14-17 kg/cm2); dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum 20 min on risers; 60-75 min cure for sub-assemblies and 90 min for the final assembly; the temperature shown is the one the cure time counts above.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: IS415
materials.notes: High reliability epoxy laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: 130-160 min at or above 190 C (product overshoot to 205 C acceptable for the heat rise); heat rise 3.5-5.0 C/min between 100 and 150 C; pressure 200-350 PSI (14-24 kg/cm2); dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell and full pressure at 100 C product temperature; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum 30 min on risers; sub-assemblies must be baked before the secondary lamination; dry innerlayers at least 120 min at 110 C.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter. The guide advises lower chip loads than standard FR-4 for this material.

materials.name: IS420
materials.notes: Lead-free epoxy laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df). Prepreg melts at about 11 C lower temperature than standard FR406 prepreg.

lamination.notes: 120 min above 190 C; heat rise 2.5-6.5 C/min between 80 and 135 C; pressure 300-350 PSI (21-25 kg/cm2) without vacuum assist, 250-300 PSI with vacuum frames or bags and 200-250 PSI in a vacuum enclosure; dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum 20 min on risers; 90-120 min cure for sub-assemblies and 120-150 min for the final assembly; the temperature shown is the one the cure time counts above.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: IS550H
materials.notes: Halogen-free, high reliability laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df). It is a higher viscosity material than halogenated FR-4, so higher pressure and heat rise are used; sub-assemblies need 3-24 h of baking at 110-180 C before the secondary lamination.

lamination.notes: Cure 190-200 C: 75 min at 200 C or 100 min at 190 C (190 C recommended for sequential lamination); heat rise 2.5-5.0 C/min between 100 and 170 C; pressure 350-450 PSI; dual stage 100 PSI (7.0 kg/cm2) after vacuum dwell and full pressure at 85 C product temperature; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum 20 min on risers.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: IS680
materials.notes: Very low loss laminate, fully cured; the guide has drilling data only (no lamination table, Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: IS680 AG
materials.notes: Very low loss laminate, fully cured; the guide has drilling data only (no lamination table, Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: P25N
materials.notes: Polyimide UL HB no-flow specialty prepreg; the guide gives a Tg above 200 C typical by TMA (a bound, not a value, so the field is empty).

lamination.notes: Cure 120 min above 190 C; full pressure 350 PSI (25 kg/cm2), very high pressure (400-500 PSI) may be needed to fill; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum more than 20 min on risers; cool at 2.8 C/min to 135-140 C.

processing.bake_note: Dry innerlayers at least 30 min at 100 C; polyimide layers need a longer drying.

materials.name: P95/P25
materials.notes: Polyimide UL HB laminate (P95) and prepreg (P25); the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: 150 min above 220 C (more for boards above 3 mm); heat rise 5.0-7.0 C/min between 80 and 140 C; pressure 200-250 PSI (14-18 kg/cm2); dual stage 3.5 kg/cm2 (50 PSI) after vacuum dwell; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum 30 min on risers; oven cure option: after 60 min at 182 C in the press the boards are cooled and post cured in an oven; the temperature shown is the one the cure time counts above.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter. The table covers bits up to 0.5 mm; ask the maker for large holes.

processing.bake_note: Dry innerlayers at least 30 min at 100 C.

materials.name: P96/P26
materials.notes: Polyimide UL V-0 laminate (P96) and prepreg (P26); the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: 150 min above 220 C (180 min above 3 mm); heat rise 80-140 C range; pressure 200-250 PSI (14-18 kg/cm2); dual stage 3.5 kg/cm2 (50 PSI) after vacuum dwell and full pressure at 90 C product temperature; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; vacuum 30 min on risers; oven cure option as for P95/P25; the temperature shown is the one the cure time counts above.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter. The table covers bits up to 0.5 mm; ask the maker for large holes.

processing.bake_note: Dry innerlayers at least 30 min at 100 C.

materials.name: TerraGreen
materials.notes: Halogen-free, very low loss laminate and prepreg; the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: Cure 190-200 C; heat rise between 110 and 150 C; pressure 375 PSI (26 kg/cm2) for 1 oz copper and up to 18 layers and 425 PSI (30 kg/cm2) above; dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell and full pressure at 90 C product temperature; use the full cycle for sub-assemblies and the final assembly; the guide gives no cure time in text form.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: TerraGreen (RF/MW)
materials.notes: Halogen-free, very low loss RF/MW laminate (laminate only); the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: 190 C for 60 min or 200 C for 45 min; heat rise 3.5-5.0 C/min between 110 and 150 C; pressure 375 PSI (26 kg/cm2) for 1 oz copper and up to 18 layers and 425 PSI (30 kg/cm2) above; dual stage 50 PSI after vacuum dwell and full pressure at 90 C product temperature.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.

materials.name: TerraGreen 400G2
materials.notes: Halogen-free, extremely low loss material (subject to the availability of L2 glass); the guide has process data only (no Tg, Td, Dk or Df).

lamination.notes: Cure 120 min at or above 200 C and never above 222 C product temperature; pressure 375-425 PSI (26.5-30 kg/cm2), 400 PSI shown as the middle of the range; dual stage 100 PSI (7.0 kg/cm2) after vacuum dwell and full pressure at 90 C product temperature; pressure reduced to 50 PSI after 30 min at cure temperature; cool at 2.8 C/min to 135-140 C.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum surface speed and chip load of the drilling table of the guide (they vary with the bit diameter); the table also lists spindle speed, infeed and retract per diameter.
